body.x: 3i, Space digitalization leading company, has presented Pivo which can help create unique photo and video content in front of 150 guests in the industry and foreign media at the event MIK Innovation Night 2019 on January 10, which was held during CES 2019, the world’s largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA.

This product can be used through smartphones which have the function to digitalize actual space by VR easily. It provides services which give the perception of visual information of the space and inspiration to consumers.

Anyone can use Pivo by combining with their smartphone which allows making their unique photo and video content; it is a bundle product of hardware and application and is a smartphone accessory aimed to achieve a concept of the personalized photographer.

Pivo has an electronic rotator which can revolve 360°; and through the exclusive application, Bluetooth motor can be controlled. Without special software, one can easily make photo/video content through Pivo hardware application.

Filming is possible while moving back and forth because of special features which are face perception, trace feature, and rotator. Also, it is portable during outdoor activity because of its small volume.

3i has started funding campaign through Kickstarter, a crowdfunding site, for two months since 2018 November 15. 3i has reached 100% of the target amount of funding 16 hours after it started the funding, and it has been drawing a lot of interest for being selected as IOT.

AVING NEWS and GMEG, a global company specializing in MICE have planned together and co-hosted MIK Innovation Hot Spot. MIK Innovation Hot Spot is made as the global project zone to give boost to startups in Korea to enter the global market. With the space provided for exhibition and pitching, it runs various programs and parties. They also hosted their first global network event MIK Innovation Night in Las Vegas.
